title: LionSR/LDT-comparator
summary: This project formalizes the main soundness theorem for the quantum low individual degree test. It proves that a projective two-prover strategy which passes the test admits polynomial measurements that are consistent with one another and with the provers' point measurements, with an explicit error bound.

formalizes.title: Quantum soundness of the classical low individual degree test

review.reason: Lean formalization of soundness for the quantum low individual degree test.
